name: hls-video-downloader
description: Manifest V3 Chrome extension that detects and downloads videos and HLS (.m3u8) streams, with quality selection, AES-128 decryption and TS->MP4 transmuxing.

scripts.zip: cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null; rm -f hls-video-downloader.zip && zip -r hls-video-downloader.zip manifest.json icons src -x '*.DS_Store'
